rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Following an Orekhovo-Zuevo court verdict of 7 October 2004 and the resulting changes to Moscow Region commission protocols, the CEC amends its protocol of 23 March 2004 on the results of the election of the President of 14 March 2004: in the line 'Число избирателей, принявших участие в выборах' read '69 572 508 (64,38%)' instead of '69 578 822 (64,39%)'. Heading: 20 January 2005, No. 135/935-4.

bounded_scope: Presidency observations for CLAUDE-C01-14 only.
